title: bupleurum stellatum f. vulgare
intro: Bupleurum stellatum f. vulgare, commonly known as Hare's ear or Stellate Hare's ear, is a plant species in the Apiaceae family. This plant is valued for its traditional use in herbal medicine, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is considered to be a "cooling" herb that can help to balance the body's energy and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Bupleurum stellatum f. vulgare include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve liver function, and enhance the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids.
